requirements.quote: `forgedock stats --card [--week|--month]`: a shareable summary (SVG/PNG + Markdown) for one repo or all repos: PRs merged, issues completed, cost per merge, issues closed before code (invalid/duplicate), release-gate catches, time saved estimate clearly labelled as an estimate.

requirements.why: PNG needs a rasterizer dependency; SVG and Markdown ship now and the issue allows SVG/PNG.

requirements.quote: Contains no private code, titles or repo names unless the user opts in (`--include-repo-names`); public repos may link to the run history.
The card renders from local stats data without network calls beyond the existing stats crawl.
Defaults expose only aggregate numbers; a test asserts no issue titles or private repo names appear unless opted in.

deliverables.change: New pure module: buildCard(report,{repo,includeRepoNames,attribution,windowLabel}) summing groups to aggregates (merged PRs from flow merged count, issues completed from issueFlow.closed total, USD per merge from cost.usdTotal/merged, closed-before-code = invalid+duplicate, gate catches = blocked acceptance+diffSize+ci+liveness, time saved = documented constant per merge labelled estimate); renderCardSvg (XML-escaped) and renderCardMarkdown; repo name shown only with includeRepoNames; footer only when attribution true.

parseArgs: --card, --week, --month (mutually exclusive, need --card; --card rejects other query modes), --include-repo-names, --out <dir>; HELP lines; runStats dispatch: --week/--month set since to now-7d/30d, reuse default buildReport path (no new fetch), read branding.show_attribution from forge.yaml (default true), print Markdown or write stats-card.svg and stats-card.md to --out.

Tests: aggregates correct from a fixture report; default output (SVG and Markdown) contains no issue title and no repo name while canary strings are present in the input; --include-repo-names shows the repo; show_attribution false removes footer; SVG escapes; runStats --card with stubbed gh makes no extra gh calls; parseArgs validation.
Add a '--card' section: flags, privacy defaults, estimate constant, attribution, SVG only (PNG not shipped).

preserve.what: Default `forgedock stats` markdown/JSON output and every existing flag in bin/stats/index.mjs parseArgs and buildReport
aggregate() return shape in bin/stats/aggregate.mjs (card consumes it read-only)

decisions.choice: Release-gate catches are the sum of blocked acceptance, diff-size, ci and liveness gate events
decisions.justification: No release-gate event exists; gates are computed at bin/stats/aggregate.mjs:170-190 and documented in docs/TELEMETRY.md:37-40

decisions.choice: No new dependency; SVG built by string template with XML escaping, PNG deferred
decisions.justification: Non-negotiable 2 (cut waste) and no rasterizer in package.json
